title: AMA-0.5 cost-probe measurement record
description: One record per primary case, plus one per legitimately activated reserve. Totals are DERIVED from the append-only timer log, never asserted independently: self-reported active minutes are the weakest evidence in the protocol and the quantity that decides STOP, so the record carries the raw events that produce them.

case_id.description: Must match a case_id present in the committed manifest.

manifest_commit.description: The selection commit — the commit that added the manifest. Recorded here, where it is an external fact, rather than inside the manifest, where it would be self-referential.

role.description: A reserve record is admissible only if the corresponding primary record has outcome=excluded_validity.

timer_log.description: Append-only active-time events. Wall-clock duration and time spent waiting on an agent or CI are not active maintainer time and must fall between a pause and a resume.

maintainer_minutes.description: Per-phase active minutes, derived from timer_log. T_independent_secondary_pass and T_disagreement_resolution are deliberately absent: without a second human the result is a LOWER BOUND on the full T_case (§10.2), not an approximation of it.

total_maintainer_minutes.description: Sum of maintainer_minutes; must equal the active time derived from timer_log. Capped at per_case_censor_minutes — reaching the censor ends the case.

outcome.description: excluded_cost_adjacent COUNTS AS CENSORED in the §10.3 tally — repository will not reproduce, toolchain unobtainable, artifacts unusable without disproportionate effort — because the exclusion is itself cost evidence. Only excluded_validity permits a reserve. `accepted` includes a completed adjudication with zero confirmed occurrences: zero is evidence, not an exclusion and not a censor, and the time it consumed still counts.

exclusion_reason.description: Required whenever outcome starts with excluded_. Names the specific defect, not a mood.

reserve_activated.description: True only on a primary record with outcome=excluded_validity, and only within max_reserve_activations.

candidate_occurrences.description: Recorded for later cost-driver analysis. Not used by the §10.3 decision, which counts outcomes rather than money.

evidence_digest.description: Digest over the case's produced evidence bundle — normalized delta, reproduction notes, adjudication output.
